_comment: Today in Disney History. Key = MM-DD. Priority: (1) Walt Disney World milestones, (2) other Disney park milestones, (3) major Walt Disney personal facts. Only well-documented dates are included. Missing days fall back to a dateless evergreen line (see fetch_data.py) so the frame NEVER shows another day's fact as if it were today. Keep blurb <= ~180 chars to fit the card.

01-01.headline: Walt Disney served as grand marshal with Mickey…
01-01.blurb: Walt Disney served as grand marshal with Mickey Mouse at his side. The parade's theme was “It's a Small World,” and featured a float promoting the new attraction coming to…

01-02.headline: World of Motion Closes
01-02.blurb: World of Motion closes at Epcot.

01-04.headline: The Disney Inn Closes
01-04.blurb: The Disney Inn closes at the Walt Disney World Resort (to become Shades of Green).

01-05.headline: Take Flight Closes
01-05.blurb: Take Flight closes at Magic Kingdom.

01-06.headline: Today is the last day of existence for Disney-MGM…
01-06.blurb: Today is the last day of existence for Disney-MGM Studios in Florida. As of tomorrow, the Disney World park will be called Disney's Hollywood Studios.

01-07.headline: Voyage of the Little Mermaid Opens
01-07.blurb: Voyage of the Little Mermaid opens at Disney's Hollywood Studios.

01-09.headline: Horizons is Opens
01-09.blurb: Horizons is open to Guests for the final day at Epcot.

01-10.headline: Walt Disney World Resort switches completely to…
01-10.blurb: Walt Disney World Resort switches completely to passport-style admission tickets.

01-15.headline: Space Mountain and Carousel of Progress Opens
01-15.blurb: Space Mountain and Carousel of Progress open at Magic Kingdom.

01-16.headline: The Walt Disney World Preview Center Opens
01-16.blurb: The Walt Disney World Preview Center opens to the public.

01-21.headline: "Circle of Life: An Environmental Fable" Debuts
01-21.blurb: "Circle of Life: An Environmental Fable" debuts at The Land at Epcot.

01-23.headline: Cirque du Soleil Opens
01-23.blurb: Cirque du Soleil opens in Downtown Disney.

02-01.headline: Tomorrowland Power & Light Co. (arcade) Opens
02-01.blurb: Tomorrowland Power & Light Co. (arcade) opens at Magic Kingdom.

02-02.headline: Roy O. Disney holds a press conference outlining…
02-02.blurb: Roy O. Disney holds a press conference outlining specific plans for construction of the Walt Disney World Resort.

02-05.blurb: Ye Olde Christmas Shop opens in Liberty Square at Magic Kingdom Park.

02-08.blurb: Disney reacquires Oswald the Lucky Rabbit from NBC Universal.

02-09.headline: The Disney Institute learning campus Opens
02-09.blurb: The Disney Institute learning campus opens at Walt Disney World.

02-13.headline: Lumiere's Kitchen Opens
02-13.blurb: Lumiere's Kitchen opens at Magic Kingdom.

02-14.headline: The American Idol Experience Opens
02-14.blurb: The American Idol Experience opens at Disney's Hollywood Studios.

02-15.headline: Lillian Bounds (Walt Disney's wife) is born
02-15.blurb: Lillian Bounds (Walt Disney's wife) is born.

02-17.headline: Disney announces the purchase of The Muppets from…
02-17.blurb: Disney announces the purchase of The Muppets from The Jim Henson Company.

02-18.headline: The Winter Olympics opening ceremony, produced by…
02-18.blurb: The Winter Olympics opening ceremony, produced by Walt Disney, is held in Squaw Valley, Calif.

02-20.blurb: WED Enterprises is renamed Walt Disney Imagineering.

02-22.headline: - The interactive fantasy game Sorcerers…
02-22.blurb: - The interactive fantasy game Sorcerers of the Magic Kingdom debuts at Magic Kingdom.

02-26.headline: Walt received the Irving G. Thailberg Memorial…
02-26.blurb: Walt received the Irving G. Thailberg Memorial Award. It is an "honorary Oscar" given to "creative producers, whose bodies of work reflect a consistently high quality of motion…

02-28.headline: —The Earl of Sandwich Opens
02-28.blurb: —The Earl of Sandwich opens in Downtown Disney.

02-29.headline: Disneyland and Magic Kingdom stay Opens
02-29.blurb: Disneyland and Magic Kingdom stay open for 24 consecutive hours on "One More Disney Day".

03-01.headline: Kali River Rapids and Maharajah Jungle…
03-01.blurb: Kali River Rapids and Maharajah Jungle Trek officially open at Disney's Animal Kingdom.

03-02.headline: —The Fort Wilderness Kennel Opens
03-02.blurb: —The Fort Wilderness Kennel opens at Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground.

03-05.headline: Journey into Imagination Opens
03-05.blurb: Journey into Imagination opens at Epcot.

03-13.blurb: Crush 'n' Gusher opens at Disney's Typhoon Lagoon.

03-14.blurb: The stand-alone McDonald's restaurant near Blizzard Beach opens at Walt Disney World.

03-16.blurb: The Walt Disney Studios (theme park) opens at Disneyland Paris.

03-17.blurb: The grand opening of Test Track is held at Epcot.

03-18.headline: Pirates of the Caribbean and the Blue…
03-18.blurb: Pirates of the Caribbean and the Blue Bayou restaurant open at Disneyland.

03-19.headline: Walt Disney Pictures releases "The Shaggy Dog"
03-19.blurb: Walt Disney Pictures releases "The Shaggy Dog".

03-20.headline: Main Street Book Shop, Penny Arcade, and…
03-20.blurb: Main Street Book Shop, Penny Arcade, and House of Magic close at Magic Kingdom.

03-22.blurb: Lake Buena Vista Shopping Village (now called Downtown Disney Marketplace) opens.

03-25.headline: Disneyana Shop Opens
03-25.blurb: Disneyana Shop opens at Magic Kingdom.

03-26.headline: "Food Rocks" Opens
03-26.blurb: "Food Rocks" opens at The Land at Epcot.

03-27.blurb: Bob Hope helps officiate the groundbreaking of Disney-MGM Studios.

03-28.headline: Port of Entry Opens
03-28.blurb: Port of Entry opens at Epcot.

03-30.headline: The Disney's Wide World of Sports box…
03-30.blurb: The Disney's Wide World of Sports box office officially opens.

03-31.headline: —Storybook Circus Opens
03-31.blurb: —Storybook Circus opens as the first phase of New Fantasyland at Magic Kingdom.

04-01.headline: —Blizzard Beach Opens
04-01.blurb: —Blizzard Beach opens at the Walt Disney World Resort.

04-02.headline: Monsters, Inc. Laugh Floor Opens
04-02.blurb: Monsters, Inc. Laugh Floor opens at Magic Kingdom.

04-03.headline: Frank G. Wells, president of The Walt Disney…
04-03.blurb: Frank G. Wells, president of The Walt Disney Company, dies in a helicopter accident.

04-04.headline: Michael Eisner assumes the presidency of The Walt…
04-04.blurb: Michael Eisner assumes the presidency of The Walt Disney Company following Frank Wells' death.

04-05.headline: Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique Opens
04-05.blurb: Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique opens in Downtown Disney at Walt Disney World.

04-06.headline: Gran Fiesta Tour Starring the Three…
04-06.blurb: Gran Fiesta Tour Starring the Three Caballeros! opens in the Mexico pavilion at Epcot.

04-07.blurb: "Who Wants to Be a Millionaire - Play It!" opens at Disney's Hollywood Studios.

04-08.headline: Treasure Island in Bay Lake (later…
04-08.blurb: Treasure Island in Bay Lake (later Discovery Island) opens at the Walt Disney World Resort.

04-09.headline: Walt Disney dedicates the grotto and wishing well…
04-09.blurb: Walt Disney dedicates the grotto and wishing well adjacent to Sleeping Beauty Castle, with donations benefitting children's charities worldwide.

04-12.headline: 'Ohana Opens
04-12.blurb: 'Ohana opens at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort.

04-13.headline: "Mickey's Kangaroo," the last…
04-13.blurb: "Mickey's Kangaroo," the last black-and-white Walt Disney Studios cartoon short, debuts.

04-15.blurb: The Walt Disney Story opens at Magic Kingdom.

04-16.blurb: Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge opens at the Walt Disney World Resort.

06-05.blurb: If You Had Wings opens at Magic Kingdom.

06-06.blurb: If You Could Fly opens at Magic Kingdom.

06-07.blurb: Mission to Mars opens at Magic Kingdom.

06-10.blurb: BET Soundstage Club opens at Pleasure Island.

06-11.blurb: Tomorrowland Transit Authority (formerly the WEDway People Mover) opens at Magic Kingdom.

07-03.blurb: Tinker Bell makes her first flight at the Walt Disney World Resort.

07-04.blurb: — The Disney-designed town of Celebration, Fla. officially opens.

07-05.headline: — The Rocketeer begins making flights during the…
07-05.blurb: — The Rocketeer begins making flights during the “Sorcery in the Sky” show at Disney's Hollywood Studios.

07-06.headline: Groundbreaking held for the Disney Institute at…
07-06.blurb: Groundbreaking held for the Disney Institute at the Walt Disney World Resort.

12-19.headline: Test Track has a soft-opening at Epcot
12-19.blurb: Test Track has a soft-opening at Epcot.

12-21.headline: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs Premieres
12-21.blurb: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premieres at the Carthay Circle Theater.

12-22.headline: Chef Mickey's Opens
12-22.blurb: Chef Mickey's opens at Disney's Contemporary Resort.

12-24.headline: Flight to the Moon Opens
12-24.blurb: Flight to the Moon opens at Magic Kingdom.

12-25.headline: Very Merry Christmas Parade is broadcast live…
12-25.blurb: Very Merry Christmas Parade is broadcast live from the Magic Kingdom for the very first time.

12-31.headline: Walt and Lillian Disney adopt a daughter, naming…
12-31.blurb: Walt and Lillian Disney adopt a daughter, naming her Sharon Mae Disney.

01-31.headline: Twilight Zone Tower of Terror – Disneyland
01-31.blurb: The Hollywood Tower Hotel opened at Disney California Adventure, bringing the famous 13-story drop out West.

04-22.headline: Disney's Animal Kingdom Opens
04-22.blurb: The fourth Walt Disney World theme park opened, anchored by the 145-foot Tree of Life and dedicated to the animal kingdom.

05-01.headline: Disney-MGM Studios Opens
05-01.blurb: The park now known as Disney's Hollywood Studios opened at Walt Disney World, themed to the golden age of Hollywood.

06-01.headline: Typhoon Lagoon Opens
06-01.blurb: Walt Disney World's tropical-storm-themed water park opened, featuring one of the largest wave pools in North America.

07-13.headline: Walt & Lillian Marry
07-13.blurb: Walt Disney married Lillian Bounds in Lewiston, Idaho. Thirty years later they'd celebrate their anniversary inside a not-yet-open Disneyland.

07-17.headline: Disneyland Opens
07-17.blurb: Walt Disney opened Disneyland in Anaheim, California – the original park that made Walt Disney World possible.

08-05.headline: Enchanted Tiki Room Debuts
08-05.blurb: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room opened at Disneyland, the first attraction ever to use Audio-Animatronics.

10-01.headline: Walt Disney World Opens!
10-01.blurb: The Magic Kingdom opened near Orlando to about 10,000 guests – the first piece of Walt Disney World Resort.

10-16.headline: The Disney Company Is Founded
10-16.blurb: Walt and Roy Disney founded the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio in Hollywood – the humble start of the whole company.

11-18.headline: Mickey Mouse Debuts
11-18.blurb: Steamboat Willie premiered in New York, introducing Mickey Mouse in the first cartoon with synchronized sound.

12-05.headline: Walt Disney Is Born
12-05.blurb: Walter Elias Disney was born in Chicago, Illinois – the visionary who would reshape animation and theme parks forever.

12-15.headline: Remembering Walt Disney
12-15.blurb: Walt Disney passed away in Burbank, California. His brother Roy carried on the Florida project and named it Walt Disney World in his honor.
